newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Australia c/account deficit widens in August.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia c/account deficit widens in August.

text.p: Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.330 billion in August from July's deficit of A$1.209 billion (revised from A$1.282 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with a seasonally adjusted deficit of A$1.554 billion in August 1995.
The unadjusted August deficit was A$1.849 billion against A$1.845 billion in July (revised from A$1.921 billion), compared with a deficit of A$2.361 billion in August 1995.
Economists had on average forecast a seasonally adjusted August current account deficit of about A$1.30 billion.
Net unreq transfers +106 million +242 million +83 million
The Bureau said exports rose two percent in August, seasonally adjusted, with rural exports rising eight percent and non-rural exports flat.
The bureau said revisions had reduced the current account deficit by A$331 million for the 1995/96 year ending June 30 and by A$76 million for the month of July.
